lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of approximately 35 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in six identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The highest-intensity clusters are concentrated in the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a visible coordinate-like lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge creating a distinct linear gradient vector.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the anterior base, while the distal and posterior regions of the fin silhouette remain low-luminance and relatively uniform.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. A white, filiform appendage is visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density stochastic distribution of small, high-luminance punctate marks that differ significantly in scale and arrangement from the structured lateral grid.
